independence: Reviewer did not draft these paragraphs. Separate agent review does not guarantee full methodological or model independence.
scope: Read original JATS front matter and body, E001-E004, C001-C004 and P001-P005. No new web lookup or new evidence added.

reference_check.rationale: Original front matter matches title, ordered nine authors, year 2013, PLoS ONE, volume 8, issue 8, e69841 and DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0069841. Reference text, CSL and BibTeX agree substantively. No independent Crossref recheck performed.

claims.rationale: Exact E001 at s2c2/p[1] supports fourteen days and five daily text messages. Wording describes sampling without treating randomized message timing as intervention assignment.

Exact E002 at s4/p[1] reports the original authors' own result. Korean wording preserves prediction and attribution. Results s3c1 and s3c2 distinguish affect and baseline-controlled life satisfaction; summary asserts neither identical timescales nor universal causality.

E003 is an exact substring of s4a/p[3]. Context calls for manipulation experiments to corroborate findings and establish definitive causal relations. Translation neither says experiments already occurred nor denies temporal information from observations.
Exact E004 and full context at s4a/p[1] identify young-adult focus and unresolved extension to other ages. Claim correctly calls for examination without asserting absence of association elsewhere.

paragraphs.rationale: Empirical sentence is supported by C001/E001. Opening and closing define this review's scope, not external findings. No randomized intervention is implied.

First sentence faithfully summarizes C002/E002. Last sentence rejects an inference of identical effects for every user, without claiming proven heterogeneity or failed replication. This is a justified authorial scope caution, not a new empirical finding. C002 alone does not identify groups that differ; reviewed E004 context leaves other ages unresolved, and s2a identifies a young-adult sample. Do not recast this caution as an original-author quotation or proof that effects differ across all users.

Expanded paraphrase includes corroborating findings, explicitly present in E003 context. Final sentence states this review's decision not to convert prediction into definitive causation and preserves the original distinction.

C004/E004 supports additional age-group examination. Final sentence correctly distinguishes unresolved generalization from demonstrated absence of the relationship elsewhere; it introduces no unsupported negative result.

Separate causal and age-generalization requirements track C003/E003 and C004/E004. Final sentence is normative interpretive guidance, not a new empirical result. Opening is read within this approved review's two focal questions, not as an exhaustive limitations inventory. Reviewed s4a also raises mechanisms/other networks and s4b effect size/affect measurement. Paragraph does not say these are the only limitations or that presenting them guarantees all conclusions are valid.

limitations: Agent review only; no human citation review or full-independence guarantee.
Single-source pilot; no systematic literature review or comprehensive correction/retraction check.
Original JATS text reviewed; no PDF visual check, supplemental-data replication or statistical reanalysis.
Export must preserve author-year citation alignment. Review applies to ledger version 16, not a rendered HWPX.
P002 scope caution and P005 guidance remain manuscript-author interpretations, not directly demonstrated original empirical findings.
